tools.name: paid_catalogue
tools.description: List the paid API routes this same server offers, with prices and which ones need no input. The MCP tools here are free and general-purpose; the paid routes are specialised (on-chain token safety, live DEX prices, wallet intel, supply-chain scans). Payment is x402 over USDC on Base — no account or A

tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Current air quality for a place: PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO and dust, plus the US and European AQI and the US AQI band ('Good', 'Unhealthy'). Takes a place name — no coordinates needed. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC o

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Resolve a place name to coordinates, country, admin region, timezone, elevation and population. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes from the USGS feed — worldwide, or within a radius of a named place. Returns magnitude, depth, tsunami flag and felt reports. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for a country and year, with local names and a past/upcoming flag. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: country_indicator
tools.description: World Bank time series for a country: gdp, gdp_per_capita, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, co2_per_capita or internet_users. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: elevation
tools.description: Ground elevation in metres for a place name. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web and return ranked title/url/snippet results, through an automatic multi-engine failover chain. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its main content as clean Markdown, boilerplate stripped. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "air_quality" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
